facts.fact: Le Matin reports that the Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Administrative Modernisation, with the Direction nationale de l'Économie numérique, held a workshop on 24 October 2024 to validate the Politique nationale de développement de l'Économie numérique (PNDEN) and its 2025-2029 action plan; adoption is not stated.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement de l'économie numérique (PNDEN)

facts.fact: The validated PNDEN comes with an action plan for 2025-2029; the article gives no cost for it.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement de l'économie numérique (PNDEN)

facts.fact: The action plan validated on 24 October 2024 covers 2025-2029; the article gives no period for the policy itself.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement de l'économie numérique (PNDEN)

facts.fact: The minister is quoted in the article as saying the previous version of the PNDEN (2015-2020) reached an execution rate of 27.30%, with 24.24% of resources mobilised; the article is dated 14 November 2024 and the period measured is 2015-2020.
